links.comparator_used: Sepsis prediction model with the calibration shift estimation/correction model versus the same sepsis prediction model without the calibration shift estimation model on two external validation cohorts.
links.outcome: Achieved positive predictive value (PPV) relative to a predefined 20% PPV target.
links.effect: When trained to achieve a PPV of 20%, PPV was 18.0% vs 12.9% and 23.1% vs 13.4% at the two external validation cohorts, respectively.
links.quote: For instance, when trained to achieve a PPV of 20%, the performance of the sepsis prediction model with and without the calibration shift estimation model was 18.0% vs 12.9% and 23.1% vs 13.4% at the two external validation cohorts, respectively.
